tactics: intro α xs h <;> cases xs with | nil => simp at h | cons a t => cases t <;> simp_all [List.dropLast]
intro α xs h <;> match xs, h with | a :: b :: t, _ => rfl
intro α xs h <;> simp [List.head_eq_getElem, List.getElem_dropLast]
intro α xs h <;> rcases xs with _ | ⟨a, _ | ⟨b, t⟩⟩ <;> simp_all
